Class GameSnapshot

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.persistency.GameSnapshot
public class GameSnapshot extends Object
Immutable snapshot of the full game state at a given point in time.

Used for persistence and game restoration: the snapshot captures every piece of information needed to reconstruct a running match exactly as it was when the snapshot was taken. Instances are created by Jackson during deserialization via the JsonCreator constructor, and by the server when saving the current game state.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameSnapshot

      public GameSnapshot(int matchId, int numPlayers, List<Card> deck, List<Card> buildings, List<Card> upperList, List<Card> lowerList, List<Tile> board, List<Tile> queue, List<Player> players, String currentPlayerNickname, GamePhaseEnum currentPhase, int currAge, int currTurn, boolean skippableDraw, List<GameSnapshot.PendingAction> toDoActions)
      Constructs a fully initialised GameSnapshot from its constituent parts.

      This constructor is used by Jackson for JSON deserialization; all parameters map directly to their corresponding JSON properties.

      Parameters:
      matchId - unique identifier of the match
      numPlayers - number of players in the match
      deck - remaining draw pile
      buildings - cards in the buildings area
      upperList - cards in the upper display row
      lowerList - cards in the lower display row
      board - tiles on the game board
      queue - tiles that constitute the queue
      players - list of all players with their state
      currentPlayerNickname - nickname of the currently active player
      currentPhase - current phase of the game
      currAge - current age (era) of the game
      currTurn - current turn within the age (era)
      skippableDraw - true if the pending draw may be skipped
      toDoActions - pending actions not yet resolved
